# Marketing by Committee

> Marketing by Committee is a fractional CMO and executive marketing advisory practice based in Edmonton, Alberta, working with energy, construction, and transportation companies, as well as small businesses across the province.

- Canonical URL: https://www.marketingbycommittee.com/
- Founder: Gurshan Dhillon, Fractional CMO. Former Chief Marketing Officer of a major Alberta energy company with corporate strategy and P&L ownership across Western Canada and the Yukon. Former Senior Communications Advisor to the Government of Alberta and spokesperson for a major regulatory body.
- Location: Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Serves the Greater Edmonton Area including Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Beaumont, Nisku and Leduc.
- Contact: info@marketingbycommittee.com, 780-952-9242.

## Services

- Fractional Services: a part-time marketing executive with a seat on your leadership team, owning the marketing function the way a CFO owns the numbers. Includes a full audit of where your spend goes and a standing quarterly review of what's next. Six month minimum. Limited seats.
- Agency Services: project-based execution. Film and media production, web development, paid media such as Google Ads, social media coordination, employer branding and recruitment marketing, government relations and public affairs, Indigenous relations, and branded merchandise design and sourcing. All run by vetted specialists, under one accountable lead.

## Who it is for

Companies of all sizes, including small businesses, in energy, transportation, construction, forestry, mining, agriculture, fleet, retail, and professional services. Typically Alberta industrial operators that need executive marketing leadership without a full-time CMO.

## Pricing

Fractional CMO placement costs $3,000 to $10,000+ per month depending on the size of the company, roughly the cost of a marketing coordinator or manager in Alberta. A full-time CMO in Canada costs $260,000 to $355,000 a year once salary, benefits, payroll taxes and recruiting fees are loaded.

## Key facts

- A fractional CMO is an experienced Chief Marketing Officer who works with your company part-time or on a defined engagement.
- A marketing agency is accountable for activity. A fractional CMO is accountable to the P&L.
- One accountable principal runs every engagement. Specialists are brought in under that principal's direction, not a rotating account team.
